passive.name: Love Tap
passive.description: Miss Fortune deals bonus physical damage whenever she basic attacks a new target.

spells.name: Double Up
spells.description: Miss Fortune fires a bouncing shot, dealing physical damage to an enemy and to another one behind them. The second shot can critically strike for physical damage. It always critically strikes if the first shot kills its target.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamageTooltip was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Strut
spells.description: Passive: After seconds of not taking damage, Miss Fortune gains Move Speed. After another seconds, this increases to . Active: Gain the passive effect's full Move Speed bonus and % Attack Speed for seconds. Love Taps reduce the Cooldown of this Ability by seconds.
spells.coverageNote: No champion damage packet is present for this cast.

spells.name: Make It Rain
spells.description: Miss Fortune rains bullets, revealing an area, Slowing by and dealing magic damage per second for seconds (total magic damage).
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamagePerSecond was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Bullet Time
spells.description: Miss Fortune channels a barrage of bullets, firing waves over seconds, dealing physical damage per wave (total physical damage). Each wave can critically strike for %i:scaleCrit% physical damage.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation PhysicalDamagePerWave was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.
